spelling.homophone.description: A word that sounds the same but is spelled and means something different.
spelling.homophone.remediation_strategy: Each spelling in a sentence that shows its meaning, then choose-the-right-word practice.
spelling.homophone.hint: Which meaning does the sentence need?
spelling.homophone.parent_script: For homophones, ask what the word means in this sentence before they choose a spelling.

spelling.transposition.remediation_strategy: Say the word slowly letter by letter, then look-say-cover-write-check.
spelling.transposition.hint: Say each letter as you write it.
spelling.transposition.parent_script: Have them spell swapped words aloud letter by letter before writing.

spelling.ie_ei.description: i and e the wrong way round.
spelling.ie_ei.remediation_strategy: Group ie and ei words, then look-say-cover-write-check.
spelling.ie_ei.hint: Is it ie or ei in this word? Picture it before you write.
spelling.ie_ei.parent_script: Sort a few ie and ei words together; the pattern sticks better in a group.

spelling.double_consonant.description: A doubled consonant missing, or one doubled that should not be.
spelling.double_consonant.remediation_strategy: Short-vowel words with the doubling rule, then look-say-cover-write-check.
spelling.double_consonant.hint: Is the vowel before it short? Then the consonant often doubles.
spelling.double_consonant.parent_script: Ask them to listen for the short vowel sound before the ending.

spelling.suffix.drop_e.description: Kept the silent e before -ing or -ed.
spelling.suffix.drop_e.remediation_strategy: Base word plus ending, dropping the e, then look-say-cover-write-check.
spelling.suffix.drop_e.hint: Drop the silent e before adding -ing.
spelling.suffix.drop_e.parent_script: Write the base word first, then have them cross out the e before adding the ending.

spelling.suffix.y_to_i.description: Kept the y where it changes to i before an ending.
spelling.suffix.y_to_i.remediation_strategy: Base word plus ending, changing y to i, then look-say-cover-write-check.
spelling.suffix.y_to_i.hint: When a consonant comes before the y, change the y to i before the ending.
spelling.suffix.y_to_i.parent_script: Show the base word and ending separately, then join them together.

spelling.silent_e.description: Left off the silent e that makes the vowel say its name.
spelling.silent_e.hint: Does the vowel say its name? Then it may need an e at the end.
spelling.silent_e.parent_script: Read pairs like hop and hope aloud so they hear what the e does.

spelling.vowel_pattern.description: Consonants right, the vowel sound spelled another way.
spelling.vowel_pattern.remediation_strategy: Words that share the vowel pattern, then look-say-cover-write-check.
spelling.vowel_pattern.hint: Which letters make this vowel sound in this word?
spelling.vowel_pattern.parent_script: Group words that share the vowel spelling and read them together.

spelling.sound_spelling.description: A consonant sound spelled another way (f/ph, k/ck/c, s/c).
spelling.sound_spelling.remediation_strategy: Words that share the spelling of the sound, then look-say-cover-write-check.
spelling.sound_spelling.hint: This sound has more than one spelling. Which one does this word use?
spelling.sound_spelling.parent_script: Point out the letters that make the sound, then cover and write.

spelling.omitted_letter.remediation_strategy: Say every syllable clearly, then look-say-cover-write-check.
spelling.omitted_letter.hint: Clap the syllables. Is every one written down?
spelling.omitted_letter.parent_script: Clap the syllables together, then check each one is on the page.

spelling.extra_letter.remediation_strategy: Look-say-cover-write-check, noticing the letter that is not there.
spelling.extra_letter.hint: Look closely. Which letter is not needed?
spelling.extra_letter.parent_script: Let them compare their word with the correct one and find the extra letter themselves.

spelling.word_specific.description: A misspelling no common pattern explains; the word is practised as itself.
spelling.word_specific.remediation_strategy: Look-say-cover-write-check on the word, spaced over a few days.
spelling.word_specific.hint: Look at the tricky part, then cover it and write the whole word.
spelling.word_specific.parent_script: For a tricky word, ask which part is hard and underline it together.

spelling.unclassified.description: No correct spelling on the page to compare with; the parent is asked.
spelling.unclassified.remediation_strategy: Parent adds the correct spelling; nothing is said to the child.
